name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Brush | Grape Ape
description: Sink into bold, grape-infused relaxation with Fresh Canna’s 2G Live Resin Concentrate Brush – Grape Ape, an indica powerhouse that delivers rich flavor and deep body effects. This easy-to-use brush applicator makes it simple to infuse your favorite prerolls, bowls, blunts, or dab rigs with pure, high-quality live resin. With juicy grape, berry, and earthy spice notes, Grape Ape brings on a calm, heavy-body high that melts away stress, tension, and worries. Perfect for evening sessions, pain relief, and deep relaxation, this strain is a go-to for indica lovers.
